qa_pairs.question: When are successful Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) allocations typically activated?
qa_pairs.answer: Generally, all successful allocations are activated in April. The exact starting date will be confirmed in your notification letter.

qa_pairs.question: Is a compute allocation received through the Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) guaranteed for its full amount?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the use of your total compute allocation cannot be fully guaranteed and is contingent on the availability of our systems. To receive the full allocation, you should run in a reasonably constant manner over the year. If you anticipate an uneven workload, it is recommended to contact the support team at support@tech.alliancecan.ca to ensure access to the resources you require.

qa_pairs.question: What options are available if a research group has used its total Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) allocation and still requires more resources?
qa_pairs.answer: Principal Investigators (PIs) can access modest quantities of storage and cloud resources through the Rapid Access Service, which also offers opportunistic compute resources without priority. For compute allocations, the batch processing priority is based on a fair-share algorithm. If you have used a large fraction of the system recently, your priority drops, but the scheduling system has a limited time window, gradually resetting your priority after a period of reduced usage.
